description: Read one check by id. Read-only, safe to call again to poll. Returns status: awaiting_verification (includes the one-line file the repo owner must add, then nothing runs until they do), queued, running, done, no_leaks, needs_review or failed. When finished it also returns the summary (each finding with severity, CWE/OWASP and days open), the plain-English report (report_md) and the tested fix (fix_sql), plus the event timeline. Use after start_check or run_check; poll every minute or so while queued or running.

check_id.description: The check id that start_check or run_check returned

name: get_check
title: Get a check
